jobs.description:
Are you an experienced project manager looking for your next big challenge? Do you know what it takes to deliver complex regulatory or strategic front to back change in an Agile operating environment?

•manage the delivery of one (or more) Investment bank change projects, as part of a larger IB-wide strategic and/or regulatory change programs. Current programmes include Fundamental Review of the Trading Book, EU T+1 Settlement, Crypto Tax Regulations, US Treasury Clearing, Mifid II
• •create and manage the project plan, agile budget, resources, risks, issues and delivery schedule
• •lead a multidisciplinary team through the full project lifecycle
• •develop strong relationships with all project stakeholders
• •provide regular updates to senior management
• •ensure that Run the Bank are kept informed and involved and able to take on their new responsibilities after go live

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Market risk quant in the Market risk model validation team in India to perform:
• Independent validation of market risk models in line with the UBS model governance policy and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities include
• Assess the model's conceptual soundness and methodology
• Check the appropriateness/quality of input data used for model development, review appropriateness of model parameters, accuracy of the model calibration etc.
• Review model outcome, impacts, or develop alternate benchmark approaches to challenge model outputs (as appropriate)
• Assess model risk, providing effective challenge to model assumptions and evaluate model limitations
• Write comprehensive validation reports, documenting the assessments to required standards
• Collaborate effectively with stakeholders globally to understand / challenge potential model risks; communicate validation findings to relevant stakeholders
• Support ongoing review of model performance and model change reviews to ensure models remain fit for purpose

jobs.title: SAP S/4 Hana Finance Functional SME

titleByLocale.en: SAP S/4 Hana Finance Functional SME
titleByLocale.it: SAP S/4 Hana Finanza Functional SME
titleByLocale.de: SAP S/4 Hana Finanzen Functional SME
titleByLocale.fr: SAP S/4 Hana Finance Functional SME

jobs.description:
"The SAP S/4HANA Finance Functional Delivery Lead supports the delivery of core SAP S/4HANA Finance capabilities within the ampliFi program, with primary accountability across General Ledger (GL), Group Reporting (GR), consolidation, reporting, and the broader Finance & Controlling (FI/CO) landscape. The role is responsible for driving disciplined execution across functional design, business validation, testing readiness, and production transition, ensuring that finance processes, close activities, and reporting outcomes are delivered in line with UBS accounting principles, governance, and control standards.
The role partners closely with Finance, Group Reporting and Consolidation teams, Data, Integration, and Technology stakeholders and acts as a functional representative for S/4HANA Finance within the delivery. It ensures that business requirements are translated into robust, well‑controlled finance solutions aligned with the target architecture and capable of supporting stable close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.

Key Responsibilities
- Support end‑to‑end functional delivery for assigned SAP S/4HANA Finance workstreams covering General Ledger, Group Reporting, consolidation, and reporting within the ampliFi finance stack, with clear ownership of outcomes.
- Contribute to and review functional designs and configurations across FI/CO to ensure alignment with agreed solution architecture, accounting principles, and reporting requirements.
- Ensure that S/4HANA Finance solutions support accurate posting, close, consolidation, and reporting outcomes, including integration with upstream subledgers and downstream reporting consumers.
- Develop and maintain delivery plans covering functional scope, milestones, dependencies, and impacts across S/4HANA Finance integration points and reporting consumption.
- Proactively manage risks, issues, and dependencies (RAID), with a focus on financial accuracy, close stability, consolidation integrity, and regulatory expectations, escalating where required.
- Coordinate day‑to‑day delivery across Finance, Group Reporting, Data, Integration, Testing, and Deployment teams to ensure coherent end‑to‑end execution across close, consolidation, and reporting cycles.
- Ensure adherence to agreed delivery standards, accounting principles, design decisions, and change control processes across the S/4HANA Finance scope.
- Support SIT and UAT execution from a functional perspective, including validation of close and consolidation scenarios, assessment of defects based on finance impact, and support for business sign‑off.
- Assist with production readiness and cutover preparation, focusing on stability of financial close and consolidation cycles, accuracy of balances and reports, and smooth transition to business‑as‑usual operations post go‑live.
"

jobs.description:
Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for someone like that who can

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Mutual Fund Core Specialist to join our operations team. This role is responsible for all operational aspects of mutual fund processing while supporting key functions that ensure accuracy and timeliness in trade execution. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative mindset to work across internal teams and external parties.

Key 
• Responsibilities:

Trade Execution & Processing

Assist in entering mutual fund trades into internal systems with precision and speed.

Confirm trade eligibility based on fund rules, account setup, and compliance guidelines.

Monitor trade activity throughout the day to ensure timely execution and settlement.

Support wire entry and ensure proper routing of funds to meet trade settlement deadlines.

Reconciliation & Issue Resolution

Reconcile mutual fund positions and transactions daily at both the CUSIP and account level.

Identify and resolve breaks or discrepancies in trade data, escalating issues when needed.

Collaborate with internal teams (operations, technology, compliance) to troubleshoot and resolve trade-related issues.

Communication & Collaboration

Interact with fund companies, custodians, and counterparties to clarify trade details and resolve exceptions.

Maintain clear and professional communication across departments to support smooth trade processing.

Support audits, internal controls, and process improvement initiatives related to reconciliation and transfer processes.

Document procedures and contribute to training materials for both onshore and offshore teams.

jobs.title: Product Owner – Digital Capabilities
jobs.description:
Do you have an entrepreneurial mindset and are you eager to understand and fulfill our clients’ needs? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization?

At UBS, we re-imagine the way we work, the way we connect with each other – our colleagues, clients and partners – and the way we deliver value. Being agile will make us more responsive, more adaptable, and ultimately more innovative.

We’re looking for a Product Owner to:

• Develop and maintain a clear product vision, strategy and roadmap for building out our digital platform solutions
• Define and maintain Objectives and Key Results (OKRs) aligned to product and business strategy
• Collaborate with end users in IB Operations to communicate art of the possible and identify business processes that require transformation and migration onto new platforms
• Assess potential use cases objectively and understand business value vs cost of solution, looking to reuse or extend existing capabilities where feasible
• Influence the design of new solutions to deliver benefit for multiple stakeholders where possible
• Maintain pod and iteration backlogs in Gitlab to a high standard
• Assist with relevant data sourcing, ensuring compliance with the firms policies
• Obtain necessary governance approvals for new use cases / solutions
• Mitigate impediments to the team’s goals, align across pods and with other crews where needed and act as your pod’s ambassadors towards internal stakeholders and clients

jobs.title: Sustainability Controller
jobs.description:
Would you like to make an impact on our Group’s sustainability governance and controls? Are you passionate about sustainability and ESG topics?
We’re looking for a Sustainability Controller like you to:
• enhance the governance framework over our Group's sustainability disclosures and reporting. This includes defining the governance process, timelines and documentation and control standards for metric owners and disclosure owners, as well as challenging and approving proposed metrics to ensure disclosures are fit for purpose
• act as a SME on various sustainability reporting topics. Be our point of contact for multiple stakeholders on matters relating to metrics, disclosures, and reporting. Coordinate with data providers to educate, enhance, and embed the control framework for sustainability reporting
• use your deep accounting and sustainability reporting knowledge to perform content and analytical reviews of our Group sustainability disclosures. Assess reporting revisions and impacts on reporting.
• support assurance activities over sustainability reporting. Act as an interface between auditors and internal stakeholders
• define, conduct and review metric reporting risk assessments
• integrate new ESG regulatory requirements and/or standards into business as usual.

jobs.title: Global Banking - Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
We are looking for a professional, degree-educated Executive Assistant with at least five years’ experience supporting at C-suite / senior level within the international financial industry to support the Country Head of Italy.

The role would suit someone who looks to thrive and add value whilst working in a demanding, diverse, fast-paced and high-profile international environment. The ability to multi-task, prioritise, exercise sound judgement and discretion is key to the success of this role.

Core Responsibilities:

• ensuring the smooth, seamless management of the Country Head of Italy’s office, working autonomously and in collaboration with the Head and his Chief of Staff. Gatekeeping both in person and over the phone.
• advanced, proactive diary management, facilitating swift set-up of all client meetings both internal and external, whilst applying good judgment and an understanding of competing priorities.
• meetings, conference calls, web conferences set-up and moderating – internally and externally.
• professional client handling and relationship building with all clients, bankers and committee groups.
• email and man management (where applicable). There will be a need for the successful candidate to manage the inbox daily and alert the Head to that which needs his attention.
• effective travel planning and management; production of accurate itineraries; plans A to Z; able to navigate systems well and apply good judgment on how to optimise the Country Head’s time.
• a small amount of personal admin will also be required.

jobs.description:
Your role
Do you enjoy working in a tax environment where accuracy and compliance matter? As a Tax Specialist, you will support VAT- and real-estate-tax-related compliance activities for Real Estate DACH, ensure high-quality data and documentation, and help deliver reconciliations, analyses and controls. In this role, you will support day-to-day tasks while actively contributing to ongoing process improvements in the tax environment.

We’re looking for a Tax Specialist to support the team with the following responsibilities:

• support quarterly fair value updates, including changes in use, input VAT adjustments and subsidies
• review and validate property allocation ratios
• prepare quarterly VAT returns; review documentation and file supporting documents to ensure timely submission
• perform annual turnover reconciliations and support VAT analyses and audits
• support preparation of real estate capital gains tax statements
• support real estate tax processes
• support direct tax and administrative tasks (e.g., supporting documents, data preparation)
• support continuous improvement of VAT processes and controls

jobs.title: Investment Analytics & Automation Analyst – ETFs
jobs.description:
Are you interested in working in the fastest growing area of passive investments?
Are you highly motivated by financial markets and portfolio construction?
Do you enjoy working in a high performing, diverse and international team?
Do you have a flair for numbers and presenting to stakeholders and clients? Then this is the role for you!

UBS Asset Management is seeking an Investment Analytics & Automation Analyst – ETFs to join the ETF & Index Fund business which is one of the key growth areas of the company.
Index tracking investment solutions have been a core competence of UBS Asset Management for over 30 years.

Key tasks:
• monthly Analytics deliverables which requires running reports,
• maintaining and updating collateral material,
• performing in-depth analysis on products and competitor offerings,
• clearly articulate and present the findings of the analysis to internal,
• strong MS Office skills, in particular Excel and PowerPoint,
• programming skills, with R coding skills being highly advantageous,
• motivated to enhance and automate processes involving data and displaying results in reports and presentations,
• having a positive attitude and willingness to learn and contribute to a high-performance team.

You will be supporting the ETF & Index Fund Investment Analytics team

UBS has a long track record of specialising in a quality indexing approach, which has contributed to them being one of the fastest growing index managers globally. Assets under management across index strategies amount to more than USD 1tn and USD 170bn in ETFs (as at Q4 25).

jobs.description:
Êtes-vous passionné par les prêts bancaires ? Vous êtes autonome, fiable et possédez une grande conscience professionnelle ? jobs.title: Spezialist/in Hypotheken und Grundbuchwesen 80 – 100%
jobs.description:
Hast du Erfahrungen in der Hypothekarverarbeitung und dem Schweizerischen Grundbuchwesen?
Ist effizientes, exaktes und verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten genau deine Stärke?
Hast du Freude an administrativen Tätigkeiten mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten?

Dann bewirb dich, denn wir wollen wachsen und suchen Verstärkung!

Deine Aufgaben:
• Selbständige Abwicklung der bewilligten Kreditgesuche

• Sicherstellung aller Bedingungen für die Freigabe der Hypotheken und Zahlungen
• Begleitung und korrekte Terminierung der Geschäftsfälle in Eigenverantwortung
• Korrespondenz mit Grundbuchämtern, Notaren, Banken und Versicherungsgesellschaften
• Pflichtbewusster Umgang mit potenziellen Risiken

jobs.description:

Are you an innovative thinker? Do you enjoy delivering enhanced change capabilities across a range of business functions? Are you passionate about IT process automation using cutting edge tooling platforms?

• Provide market-making and risk management for all Foreign Exchange (FX) Options emerging market currency pairs to the UBS client franchise utilizing specialized knowledge of internally developed tools and systems, including Market Maker Gui, FX Cockpit, Thor, Levitas and Brokertron.

jobs.title: Payment Investigator
jobs.description:
Your role

Are you incredibly organized with an eye for detail? Do you know how to take care of business?

We are looking for an Operations Specialist who will be responsible for end-to-end processing of paper and electronic check items cleared through the Federal Reserve, including posting adjustments, researching discrepancies, and processing Fed returns. This role ensures timely, accurate settlement and strict compliance with Federal Reserve, Reg CC, and internal bank policies.

Key Responsibilities:
• Investigate and resolve client inquiries related to payment issues, including sanctions holds, returned funds, and payment cancellations.
• Monitor and manage payment queues, ensuring timely resolution of flagged or delayed transactions.
• Collaborate with internal teams (e.g., Compliance, Operations, Risk) to resolve complex cases and escalate issues when necessary.
• Maintain accurate records of investigations and resolutions in accordance with regulatory and internal standards.
• Identify trends or recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
• Support audit and compliance reviews by providing documentation and insights into investigation processes.
